accountingPolicy: These are required outcomes, not observed reviewer evidence. Build actual accounting from the unedited report and trace; do not mark a file Reviewed merely because this oracle expects it or because the report omitted it.

common.requiredFieldStates: Each actual finding has evidence-backed Origin and Reproduction; no fabricated numeric probability. Reproduction is Not Run because runtime evidence is not delivered and execution is forbidden.
common.recommendationConsistency: Conclusion and final recommendation must carry the same necessary prerequisites; new optional checks must not become gates.
common.sourceScope: Only this declared packet. No claims of complete repository or client/runtime coverage.

findings.introducedBy: unstaged index-to-after change; staged parameter rename preserves behavior
findings.trigger: HTTPS origin and profile route have both boundary slashes or neither; exactly one remains correct.
findings.repair: Restore established separator normalization in the current helper; no new abstraction or ownership boundary.

fileEvidence.requires: before/index/after and direct consumer; all four separator combinations plus preserved query
rename identity, identical body, declared supported inputs and updated entry mapping
producer/current parity and consumer's path-input contract; generated type is not evidence
removed body, no side effects and declared absence of consumers

FC-Q-001.stableComparison: Apply the same finding/behavior/scope gates; absence of the new file-summary syntax is not a stable-version failure. Evaluate file treatment independently from the trace/report.

fileEvidence.requires: explicit missing target implementation; cannot compare its logout/account-switch contract
before/after local header and empty/nonempty token branches; external token-owner behavior remains separately unavailable

FC-D-001.requiredPrerequisite: Obtain the target session implementation and compare logout/account-switch/current-token behavior before whole-scope approval. Do not fabricate a defect to explain the gap.
FC-D-001.stableComparison: Stable must also identify the unavailable critical evidence and avoid unconditional approval; only the candidate requires exact file-summary grammar.

FC-F-001.requires: Compare original-to-problem attribution, problem-to-fixed behavior and the unchanged direct caller; preserve query and all supported slash combinations. No runtime closure requirement was imposed.
